jei_info.themelios.slabs: Slabs are half-height building pieces that can be placed at the bottom or top of a block space. Two matching slabs can form a double slab.
jei_info.themelios.stairs: Stairs form stepped surfaces for paths, steps and roofs. Search for steps or staircase to find them quickly.
jei_info.themelios.walls: Walls form low barriers and connect to nearby blocks. Search for walls to find the material and finish you need.
jei_info.themelios.layers: Layers are thin decorative panels. Horizontal and vertical variants let you build up cladding and trim in small increments.
jei_info.themelios.slices_and_posts: Slices and posts are small shape pieces for fine detailing. Search for thin, slice, eighth, beam or rod.
jei_info.themelios.cylinders: Cylinders are round building pieces in small and large sizes. Search for cylinder, column, pillar or round.
jei_info.themelios.cornices: Cornices are decorative mouldings in small and large sizes for finishing edges. Search for cornice, moulding, molding or trim.
jei_info.themelios.weaves: Weave blocks combine two stone materials in a patterned surface. Each weave is ordered under the first material in its name.
